title: GTK2 palette refresh reaches already-open X11 windows

reference.session: Private Xvfb; private XDG home under ~/tempia

change.behavior: When the GTK2 palette runtime reports native_reload_required, the KDE companion bridge broadcasts GTK2's native _GTK_READ_RCFILES ClientMessage to X11 top-level clients. Unchanged GTK2 output does not trigger the broadcast.
change.color_policy: The notification changes no colors. GTK2 pixmaps and RC continue to derive color values from the current KDE palette roles.
change.limits: GTK2 reload uses X11. A missing DISPLAY or unavailable X11 server is reported as an error; no GTK2 Wayland reload path is claimed. Other toolkit clients may receive the event and ignore its unrecognized message type.

native_reload_tests.command: TMPDIR=~/tempia/i167-r118/xvfb xvfb-run -a env IRIX_GTK2_RELOAD_TEST=1 GTK_MODULES= python3 -B tests/test_gtk2_reload_notify.py -v

unverified: The complete KDE Color Scheme/XSettings notification -> companion service -> GTKConfig export -> GTK2 broadcast path was not run as an isolated end-to-end session.
No live user GTK2 window, personal theme/profile, XChat, installed service, or MAME guest was modified or restarted.
This receipt proves native reload behavior and integration dispatch in isolation; it does not prove historical visual fidelity or human acceptance.
next: Isolate and verify the KDE/XSettings-to-companion-to-GTK2 end-to-end notification path. Then audit the remaining GTK2 acceptance gaps under I167; keep the user profile and XChat untouched until the GTK2 stage is complete.
progress_estimate: About 98% technical coverage for I167; this is not a historical visual-fidelity score or human approval.
